quests.title: Chain of Custody
quests.desc: The records clerk, Lyd Marven, is the weak link in the prison's administration. Gain leverage over him to control the flow of paper.

stages.text: Case the Records Office and learn of Lyd's anxieties and habits.
Find Lyd's hidden stash of Dreammilk or steal his personal journal.

quests.title: A Crumb of Kindness
quests.desc: The inmates' tension is rising. Perform acts of kindness to lower the temperature, earning the trust of Gaoler Bram and the prisoners.

stages.text: Deliver an Unsent Family Letter, smuggle medicine to the infirmary, or provide extra food rations.
